title: Another resource is loaded from path (possible cyclic resource inclusion)
key_points: Godot produces ERROR: Another resource is loaded from path 'res://main.tscn::h2yge' (possible cyclic resource inclusion).
This error occurs in a simple scene with one exported Curve resource.
The issue has been reproduced on Godot versions 4.6.1, 4.6, and 4.5.
limitations: Reproduction may require significant attempts (7 save/load attempts for some tested versions).
Error visibility can be inconsistent and logging is sometimes needed to confirm occurrence.
Scope appears limited to recent Godot versions; older ones were not reproduced in the report.
asserts: Godot produces an error indicating possible cyclic resource inclusion when loading certain resources, particularly affecting Curve and potentially other exported resources.
scope: The source asserts that this cyclic resource loading issue affects Godot versions 4.6.1, 4.6, and 4.5, with less prevalence in older versions.
